s22.name: Samsung Galaxy S22 (SM-S901U1)
s22.isa: ARMv9-A: NEON, dotprod, i8mm, bf16, fp16
notes: Runs up to 2026-11-05 were made while the phone charged over USB: Samsung's thermal engine then capped the clocks on skin temperature (X2 down to 1.61 of 3.00 GHz); they are labelled thermal-throttled or, before the cap check existed, unknown-caps.

oneplus-open.name: OnePlus Open (CPH2551)
oneplus-open.isa: ARMv9-A: NEON, dotprod, i8mm, bf16, fp16
notes: Stock settings, screen off: the vendor power policy holds the clock ceilings below the maximum with no thermal event (Android thermal status 0): X3 2.23 of 3.19 GHz, A715/A710 1.79 of 2.80 GHz. Runs are labelled vendor-policy and the ceilings are recorded per run. With the screen on the ceilings move (3.19, then 2.48 and 2.23 GHz under load), so they are not a steadier condition.

moto-e13.name: Motorola moto e13
notes: Entry-level phone (2 GB RAM). The A55 cluster's frequency ceiling (policy0 scaling_max_freq) is not readable without root, so only the A75 cluster's ceiling is checked.

redmi-9a.name: Xiaomi Redmi 9A (M2006C3LG)
redmi-9a.isa: ARMv8-A CPU running 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a): NEON only
notes: 32-bit Android: runs the armeabi-v7a build, whose NEON kernels are AArch32 builds of the arm64 ones (runtime/kernels/neon_a32.h, since 2026-11-12; earlier runs used the portable C++ fallback). The int8 stages use AArch32 NEON kernels too (since 2026-11-12: int8_full_neon through neon_a32.h, VMULL.S8 GEMM tiles instead of SDOT/I8MM for int8_full and optimized_int8; the development log (not published)). The Cortex-A53 in 32-bit mode cannot overlap vector loads with vector arithmetic (the development log (not published)).
